== Notes ==
* This skill's maximum [[range]] is slightly larger than [[compass]] range.

{{anomaly|If this skill is cast at the exact moment of your pet's death, the pet will be resurrected without any of your skills being [[disable]]d.}}

{{anomaly|Using this skill without a pet will still use the energy and return the message "Your pet is out of range."}}
{{anomaly|This skill bypasses the effects of [[Frozen Soil]]}}
